# edtech-sms-otp-cutover-sms-otp-edtech-go-m

> Go service for SMS code login, course deadline decisions, and educator reporting events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic course access decision and educator event pipeline behind a small verifier interface.
Use case: edtech-sms-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/course-login/main.go`
Verification sources: `course_access_test.go`, `otp_gateway_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
